title: BJP legislators in Hubbali protesting to ‘reclaim temple land’  court arrest; police clamped prohibitory orders as a precaution
description: Protesting against what they termed as encroachment over temple pond to lay road, Deputy Leader of Opposition in the Legislative Assembly Arvind Bellad, BJP legislators Mahesh Tenginakai, Pradeep Shettar, Sri Rama Sene chief Pramod Mutalik and scores of BJP and Hindutva activists courted arrest.
